rows.question: What is the current building key, building street address, city, state, and postal code of the history department?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH fclt_building_current AS (
SELECT
  `fac_building`.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY`   AS `FCLT_BUILDING_KEY`,
  `fac_building`.`BUILDING_NUMBER`    AS `BUILDING_NUMBER`,
  `fac_building`.`BUILDING_NAME`      AS `BUILDING_NAME`,
  `fac_building`.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE` AS `WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`
FROM `fac_building`
)
SELECT
  fbc.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
  CONCAT(
    fba.STREET_NUMBER,
    CASE WHEN fba.STREET_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND fba.STREET_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN ' ' ELSE '' END,
    COALESCE(fba.STREET_NAME, ''),
    CASE WHEN fba.STREET_SUFFIX IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(' ', fba.STREET_SUFFIX) ELSE '' END
  ) AS BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
  fba.CITY,
  fba.STATE,
  fba.POSTAL_CODE
FROM fclt_building_current AS fbc
JOIN fclt_building_address AS fba
  ON fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbc.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN fclt_organization AS fo
  ON fo.DLC_KEY = fbc.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
WHERE LOWER(fo.DLC_NAME) = LOWER('History')
  AND fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'

WITH iap_subject_category_master AS (
  SELECT
    `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY`,
    `IAP_CATEGORY_NAME`
  FROM `iap_subject_category`
),
iap_subject_detail_rows AS (
  SELECT
    `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY`,
    `TERM_CODE`,
    `FEE`,
    `ATTENDANCE`,
    `MAX_ENROLLMENT`,
    `ACTIVITY_TITLE`,
    `IS_CANCELLED`
  FROM `iap_subject_detail`
  -- carry key/id columns through CTEs so views stay joinable
)
SELECT
  m.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AS IAP_CATEGORY_NAME,
  d.TERM_CODE AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  SUM(COALESCE(d.FEE, 0)) AS TOTAL_FEE_COLLECTED,
  COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_IAP_SUBJECTS,
  MIN(
    COALESCE(
      -- prefer numeric ATTENDANCE when it is numeric text; otherwise use MAX_ENROLLMENT
      CASE
        WHEN d.ATTENDANCE IS NOT NULL
          AND TRIM(d.ATTENDANCE) <> ''
          AND TRIM(d.ATTENDANCE) REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+$'
        THEN CAST(TRIM(d.ATTENDANCE) AS SIGNED)
        ELSE NULL
      END,
      d.MAX_ENROLLMENT
    )
  ) AS MIN_ENROLLMENT,
  MAX(
    COALESCE(
      CASE
        WHEN d.ATTENDANCE IS NOT NULL
          AND TRIM(d.ATTENDANCE) <> ''
          AND TRIM(d.ATTENDANCE) REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+$'
        THEN CAST(TRIM(d.ATTENDANCE) AS SIGNED)
        ELSE NULL
      END,
      d.MAX_ENROLLMENT
    )
  ) AS MAX_ENROLLMENT
FROM iap_subject_category_master m
JOIN iap_subject_detail_rows d
  ON m.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
WHERE d.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL
  -- exclude rows that are cancelled
  AND (d.IS_CANCELLED IS NULL OR d.IS_CANCELLED <> 'Y')
  -- exclude rows where fee and both enrollment fields are NULL (require at least one)
  AND NOT (
    d.FEE IS NULL
    AND (d.ATTENDANCE IS NULL OR TRIM(d.ATTENDANCE) = '')
    AND d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL
  )
GROUP BY m.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.TERM_CODE
ORDER BY m.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ASC, d.TERM_CODE ASC

    `FEE`,

  FROM `iap_subject_detail`
  WHERE `TERM_CODE` IS NOT NULL
),
iap_sponsor_basic AS (
  -- only sponsors that have at least one iap_subject_detail (ensures we exclude sponsors with zero sessions)
  SELECT

    s.`SPONSOR_NAME`

    `IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY`,
    `HAS_SESSION_INFO`
  FROM `iap_subject_session`
)

  COUNT(DISTINCT d.`IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY`) AS NUM_SESSIONS,

      NULLIF(TRIM(d.`MAX_ENROLLMENT`), '') + 0,

-- compute session length in minutes, handling times that roll past midnight
iap_session_minutes AS (
  SELECT
    `IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY`,
    CASE
      WHEN `SESSION_START_TIME` IS NULL OR `SESSION_END_TIME` IS NULL
        OR TRIM(`SESSION_START_TIME`) = '' OR TRIM(`SESSION_END_TIME`) = '' THEN NULL
      WHEN STR_TO_DATE(SESSION_START_TIME, '%l%i%p') IS NULL
        OR STR_TO_DATE(SESSION_END_TIME, '%l%i%p') IS NULL THEN NULL
      ELSE (
        (TIME_TO_SEC(STR_TO_DATE(SESSION_END_TIME, '%l%i%p'))
         - TIME_TO_SEC(STR_TO_DATE(SESSION_START_TIME, '%l%i%p')))/60
      ) + (CASE WHEN TIME_TO_SEC(STR_TO_DATE(SESSION_END_TIME, '%l%i%p')) 
                 < TIME_TO_SEC(STR_TO_DATE(SESSION_START_TIME, '%l%i%p'))
               THEN 24*60 ELSE 0 END)
    END AS session_minutes
  FROM iap_session_raw
),
-- defensive selection from iap_subject_detail: try multiple possible identifier/fee column names
iap_subject_detail_rows AS (
  SELECT
    `IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY`,
    -- carry original key for joins
    `IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY` AS IAP_SESSION_KEY,
    -- pick a subject identifier from several possible columns if they exist (NULLs if not)
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(CAST(NULLIF(`SUBJECT_ID`, '') AS CHAR), ''),
      NULLIF(CAST(NULLIF(`SUBJECT_CODE`, '') AS CHAR), ''),
      NULLIF(CAST(NULLIF(`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`, '') AS CHAR), ''),
      NULLIF(CAST(NULLIF(`SECTION_ID`, '') AS CHAR), ''),

    COALESCE(
      (CASE WHEN `FEE` REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST(`FEE` AS DECIMAL(12,2)) ELSE NULL END),

      (CASE WHEN `COURSE_FEE` REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST(`COURSE_FEE` AS DECIMAL(12,2)) ELSE NULL END),

    `BUILDING_NAME`
  FROM `fac_building`

  COALESCE(building_aggr.total_building_heights, 0) AS total_building_heights

  SELECT
    fb.`DLC_KEY`,

      COALESCE(
        NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(fb.`ASSIGNABLE_AREA` AS CHAR)), ''),
        NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(fb.`EXT_GROSS_AREA` AS CHAR)), '')
      ) + 0

  GROUP BY fb.`DLC_KEY`

  ON building_aggr.`DLC_KEY` = dlcs.`DLC_KEY`

    b.`DLC_KEY`,

  WHERE `DLC_KEY` IS NOT NULL

  WHERE COALESCE(ssu.`DLC_KEY`, fo.`DLC_KEY`) IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY COALESCE(ssu.`DLC_KEY`, fo.`DLC_KEY`)
) AS sup_aggr

WITH academic_term_lookup_precedence AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(at.TERM_CODE, ata.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_CODE) AS TERM_CODE,
    CASE
      WHEN at.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN at.TERM_DESCRIPTION
      WHEN ata.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION
      ELSE atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION
    END AS TERM_DESCRIPTION,
    CASE
      WHEN at.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN at.IS_CURRENT_TERM
      WHEN ata.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM
      ELSE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM
    END AS IS_CURRENT_TERM
  FROM (
    SELECT TERM_CODE FROM academic_terms WHERE TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT TERM_CODE FROM academic_terms_all WHERE TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT TERM_CODE FROM academic_term_parameter WHERE TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL
  ) AS all_terms
  LEFT JOIN academic_terms AS at ON all_terms.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
  LEFT JOIN academic_terms_all AS ata ON all_terms.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE
  LEFT JOIN academic_term_parameter AS atp ON all_terms.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE
),
term_codes_in_tip AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT TERM_CODE FROM tip_subject_offered
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT TERM_CODE FROM tip_detail
),
subject_offered_agg AS (
  SELECT
    TERM_CODE,
    COUNT(*) AS count_subject_rows,
    -- prefer TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY when present: count distinct non-null keys; if all null, fall back to distinct (TERM_CODE, SUBJECT_ID)
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) > 0 THEN COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY)
      ELSE COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT_WS('||', TERM_CODE, SUBJECT_ID))
    END AS num_distinct_tip_subjects_offered,
    -- MIN/MAX over NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS; if all NULL, MySQL MIN/MAX return NULL which matches requirement
    MIN(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students,
    MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_num_enrolled_students,
    COUNT(DISTINCT OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) AS num_distinct_schools_offering_subjects
  FROM tip_subject_offered
  GROUP BY TERM_CODE
),
detail_agg AS (
  SELECT
    TERM_CODE,
    COUNT(*) AS count_detail_rows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_distinct_materials_referenced
  FROM tip_detail
  GROUP BY TERM_CODE
)
SELECT
  tc.TERM_CODE,
  atl.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  atl.IS_CURRENT_TERM,
  COALESCE(soa.num_distinct_tip_subjects_offered, 0) AS num_distinct_tip_subjects_offered,
  COALESCE(dag.num_distinct_materials_referenced, 0) AS num_distinct_materials_referenced,
  soa.min_num_enrolled_students,
  soa.max_num_enrolled_students,
  COALESCE(soa.num_distinct_schools_offering_subjects, 0) AS num_distinct_schools_offering_subjects,
  COALESCE(soa.count_subject_rows, 0) + COALESCE(dag.count_detail_rows, 0) AS total_records
FROM term_codes_in_tip AS tc
LEFT JOIN academic_term_lookup_precedence AS atl
  ON atl.TERM_CODE = tc.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN subject_offered_agg AS soa
  ON soa.TERM_CODE = tc.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN detail_agg AS dag
  ON dag.TERM_CODE = tc.TERM_CODE
ORDER BY tc.TERM_CODE

    COALESCE(src.SECTION_ID,'')
  )) AS TOTAL_COURSE_TYPES
FROM (

  SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUBJECT_ID, SECTION_ID, FALL_INSTRUCTORS, SPRING_INSTRUCTORS
  FROM drupal_course_catalog
) AS src

  SELECT
    TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.instructors, ',', n.n), ',', -1)) AS Instructor,
    t.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year,

    COALESCE(fr2.dept_vals, '')

    CASE WHEN fr.org_vals IS NOT NULL AND fr2.org_vals IS NOT NULL THEN ',' ELSE '' END,
    COALESCE(fr2.org_vals, '')
  )) AS ORGANIZATIONS,

    WHEN fr.max_floor_num IS NOT NULL AND fr2.max_floor_num IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST(fr.max_floor_num, fr2.max_floor_num)
    WHEN fr.max_floor_num IS NOT NULL THEN fr.max_floor_num
    WHEN fr2.max_floor_num IS NOT NULL THEN fr2.max_floor_num
    WHEN fr.max_floor_lex IS NOT NULL AND fr2.max_floor_lex IS NOT NULL THEN 
      CASE WHEN fr.max_floor_lex >= fr2.max_floor_lex THEN fr.max_floor_lex ELSE fr2.max_floor_lex END
    WHEN fr.max_floor_lex IS NOT NULL THEN fr.max_floor_lex
    WHEN fr2.max_floor_lex IS NOT NULL THEN fr2.max_floor_lex
    ELSE NULL

  CASE
    WHEN fr.min_floor_num IS NOT NULL AND fr2.min_floor_num IS NOT NULL THEN LEAST(fr.min_floor_num, fr2.min_floor_num)
    WHEN fr.min_floor_num IS NOT NULL THEN fr.min_floor_num

      CASE WHEN fr.min_floor_lex <= fr2.min_floor_lex THEN fr.min_floor_lex ELSE fr2.min_floor_lex END
    WHEN fr.min_floor_lex IS NOT NULL THEN fr.min_floor_lex
    WHEN fr2.min_floor_lex IS NOT NULL THEN fr2.min_floor_lex
    ELSE NULL
  END AS LOWEST_FLOOR,
  COALESCE(fr.total_rooms,0) + COALESCE(fr2.total_rooms,0) AS TOTAL_ROOMS

LEFT JOIN (

    MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(`FLOOR`),'')) AS max_floor_lex,
    MIN(NULLIF(TRIM(`FLOOR`),'')) AS min_floor_lex,
    MAX(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(`FLOOR`),'') AS SIGNED)) AS max_floor_num,
    MIN(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(`FLOOR`),'') AS SIGNED)) AS min_floor_num,
    COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(FCLT_ROOM_KEY, CONCAT(FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,'::',TRIM(ROOM)))) AS total_rooms
  FROM (
    SELECT
      fr.*,
      COALESCE(sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, fr.DEPT_CODE, fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS DEPT_NAME,
      COALESCE(fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS ORG_NAME

    WHERE fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
  ) t

    COALESCE(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,0) AS num_enrolled

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    COALESCE(lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, NULLIF(lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,'')) AS instr_identifier,
    COALESCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,0) AS num_enrolled

  FROM tip_subject_offered_rows tso

    instr_identifier,

  WHERE YEAR IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(YEAR) <> ''
  GROUP BY instr_identifier

-- convert year texts to integers where possible

  ON (m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID <> '' AND m.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID = mac.instr_identifier)

      LOWER(COALESCE(OFFICE_LOCATION, '')) = '24'
    )

  -- also collect raw OFFICE_LOCATION strings from those tables so we can match member_string values that are office locations

  WHERE OFFICE_LOCATION IS NOT NULL AND OFFICE_LOCATION <> ''

    )

    -- prefer MIT_ID, else RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, else FALL_INSTRUCTORS / SPRING_INSTRUCTORS (which may be comma lists)
    -- To count distinct instructors reliably from FALL_INSTRUCTORS/SPRING_INSTRUCTORS we will treat the entire field as one identifier if MIT_ID not present.
    COALESCE(NULLIF(sot.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,''), NULLIF(sot.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,''), NULLIF(sot.FALL_INSTRUCTORS,''), NULLIF(sot.SPRING_INSTRUCTORS,'')) AS INSTRUCTOR_ID
  FROM subject_offering_terms sot
),
-- Aggregate distinct instructor counts per subject, year, and term type (FA/SP)
distinct_instructor_counts AS (
  SELECT
    ibo.SUBJECT_ID,
    ibo.TERM_YEAR,
    RIGHT(ibo.TERM_CODE,2) AS TERM_TYPE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ibo.INSTRUCTOR_ID) AS NUM_DISTINCT_INSTRUCTORS
  FROM instructors_by_offering ibo
  WHERE ibo.INSTRUCTOR_ID IS NOT NULL
    AND RIGHT(ibo.TERM_CODE,2) IN ('FA','SP')
  GROUP BY
    ibo.SUBJECT_ID,
    ibo.TERM_YEAR,
    RIGHT(ibo.TERM_CODE,2)
)
SELECT
  sot.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  sot.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS SCHOOL_NAME,
  sot.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID,
  sot.SUBJECT_TITLE AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
  -- COURSE_LEVEL: use MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER when present (as in original), else NULL
  sot.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER AS COURSE_LEVEL,
  COALESCE(sot.TOTAL_UNITS, 0) AS TOTAL_UNITS,
  -- OFFER_TERM literal
  CASE WHEN RIGHT(at.TERM_CODE,2) = 'FA' THEN 'Fall'
       WHEN RIGHT(at.TERM_CODE,2) = 'SP' THEN 'Spring'
  END AS OFFER_TERM,
  at.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  -- NUM_DISTINCT_FALL_INSTRUCTORS: lookup from aggregated counts for same subject and same TERM_YEAR where TERM_TYPE='FA'
  COALESCE(fall_cnt.NUM_DISTINCT_INSTRUCTORS, 0) AS NUM_DISTINCT_FALL_INSTRUCTORS,
  -- NUM_DISTINCT_SPRING_INSTRUCTORS: lookup for TERM_TYPE='SP'
  COALESCE(spr_cnt.NUM_DISTINCT_INSTRUCTORS, 0) AS NUM_DISTINCT_SPRING_INSTRUCTORS
FROM subject_offering_terms sot
JOIN academic_term_codes at
  ON at.TERM_CODE = sot.TERM_CODE
  -- only FA and SP terms per requirements
  AND RIGHT(at.TERM_CODE,2) IN ('FA','SP')
-- determine year portion to join instructor aggregates
LEFT JOIN distinct_instructor_counts fall_cnt
  ON fall_cnt.SUBJECT_ID = sot.SUBJECT_ID
  AND fall_cnt.TERM_TYPE = 'FA'
  AND fall_cnt.TERM_YEAR = LEFT(at.TERM_CODE,4)
LEFT JOIN distinct_instructor_counts spr_cnt
  ON spr_cnt.SUBJECT_ID = sot.SUBJECT_ID
  AND spr_cnt.TERM_TYPE = 'SP'
  AND spr_cnt.TERM_YEAR = LEFT(at.TERM_CODE,4)
-- ensure we only return subjects that have at least one FA or SP offering in the same academic year:
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM subject_offering_terms sot2
  WHERE sot2.SUBJECT_ID = sot.SUBJECT_ID
    AND LEFT(sot2.TERM_CODE,4) = LEFT(sot.TERM_CODE,4)
    AND RIGHT(sot2.TERM_CODE,2) IN ('FA','SP')
)
GROUP BY
  sot.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
  sot.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME,
  sot.SUBJECT_ID,
  sot.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  sot.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER,
  sot.TOTAL_UNITS,
  OFFER_TERM,
  at.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  at.TERM_CODE,
  fall_cnt.NUM_DISTINCT_INSTRUCTORS,
  spr_cnt.NUM_DISTINCT_INSTRUCTORS
ORDER BY
  sot.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ASC,
  sot.SUBJECT_ID ASC,
  FIELD(CASE WHEN RIGHT(at.TERM_CODE,2) = 'FA' THEN 'Fall' WHEN RIGHT(at.TERM_CODE,2) = 'SP' THEN 'Spring' END, 'Fall','Spring')

    SELECT

LEFT JOIN cis_hass_attribute AS c

LEFT JOIN drupal_course_catalog AS sc

rows.question: Group subjects by cluster type, department offering the subject, and the school name. For each group, list the cluster type, name of the department, school name, whether the department grants degrees, total number of subjects, total enrollment, and average enrollment. Exclude clusters or schools with no student data.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH department_degree_flag AS (
  SELECT
    sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING AS IS_DEGREE_GRANTING
  FROM sis_department sd
)
SELECT
  gs.CLUSTER_TYPE AS cluster_type,
  gs.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
  gs.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name,
  gs.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING AS is_degree_granting,
  COUNT(DISTINCT gs.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_number_of_subjects,
  SUM(gs.subject_enrollment) AS total_enrollment,
  AVG(gs.subject_enrollment) AS average_enrollment
FROM (
  -- derive one row per subject with chosen enrollment and grouping keys
  SELECT
    COALESCE(ss.CLUSTER_TYPE, so.CLUSTER_TYPE, so.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC, ss.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC) AS CLUSTER_TYPE,
    COALESCE(so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COALESCE(so.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ss.SCHOOL_NAME) AS SCHOOL_NAME,
    ddf.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING AS IS_DEGREE_GRANTING,
    COALESCE(ss.SUBJECT_ID, so.SUBJECT_ID) AS SUBJECT_ID,
    COALESCE(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS subject_enrollment
  FROM subject_summary ss
  LEFT JOIN subject_offered so
    ON ss.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID
    AND ss.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE
  LEFT JOIN department_degree_flag ddf
    ON COALESCE(so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE) = ddf.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  WHERE COALESCE(ss.SUBJECT_ID, so.SUBJECT_ID) IS NOT NULL
) AS gs
WHERE gs.subject_enrollment IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  gs.CLUSTER_TYPE,
  gs.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  gs.SCHOOL_NAME,
  gs.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING
HAVING SUM(gs.subject_enrollment) > 0
ORDER BY SUM(gs.subject_enrollment) DESC

rows.question: For each course, provide the room number of course location, building name, building number, building city, building state, area, organization name, room usage, term code, course level, the total number of subjects, unique meeting times, and total units. Do not include meet place or meet times with NULL values.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  co.SECTION_ID AS SECTION_ID,
  -- assume MEET_PLACE holds a room identifier like "B123-101" or "32-101"; keep original value trimmed
  NULLIF(TRIM(co.MEET_PLACE), '') AS ROOM_NUMBER,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
  b.BUILDING_NUMBER AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
  -- fac_building_address table DDL was truncated in the schema; defensively select columns only if they exist.
  -- Use fba columns if present, otherwise NULL.
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(fba.BUILDING_CITY, NULL) IS NOT NULL THEN fba.BUILDING_CITY ELSE NULL END AS BUILDING_CITY,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(fba.BUILDING_STATE, NULL) IS NOT NULL THEN fba.BUILDING_STATE ELSE NULL END AS BUILDING_STATE,
  fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS BUILDING_AREA,
  fb.COST_CENTER_CODE AS ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  co.IS_LECTURE_SECTION AS ROOM_USAGE,
  co.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
  CASE
    WHEN co.SUBJECT_NUMBER REGEXP '^[0-3][0-9]{2}$' THEN 'Undergraduate'
    WHEN co.SUBJECT_NUMBER REGEXP '^[4-9][0-9]{2}$' THEN 'Graduate'
    ELSE 'Unknown'
  END AS COURSE_LEVEL,
  subj_counts.TOTAL_SUBJECTS AS TOTAL_NUMBER_OF_SUBJECTS,
  mt.UNIQUE_MEET_TIMES AS UNIQUE_MEETING_TIMES,
  COALESCE(co.TOTAL_UNITS, 0) AS TOTAL_UNITS
FROM course_catalog_subject_offered co
-- require non-null/non-empty meet_place and meet_time per request
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(MEET_PLACE) AS MEET_PLACE
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered
  WHERE MEET_PLACE IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(MEET_PLACE) <> ''
) mp ON TRIM(co.MEET_PLACE) = mp.MEET_PLACE
-- join to buildings by BUILDING_NUMBER; some MEET_PLACE values may include room appended to building number.
-- Try to join on exact match first; if MEET_PLACE includes a dash or space, extract leading token as building number.
LEFT JOIN buildings b ON b.BUILDING_NUMBER = TRIM(co.MEET_PLACE)
-- fallback: if direct match failed, attempt to match by extracting leading token before first non-alphanumeric (dash/space)
LEFT JOIN buildings b_alt ON b_alt.BUILDING_NUMBER = 
  TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(co.MEET_PLACE, ' ', 1), '-', 1))
-- prefer b when available, otherwise b_alt
LEFT JOIN buildings _b_pref ON (_b_pref.BUILDING_KEY IS NULL) -- dummy to allow selection below
-- use a derived table to pick the building from either join
-- (MySQL doesn't allow choosing between joins in SELECT easily; instead use COALESCE in select list referencing joined aliases)
-- fac_building and fac_building_address use building number or fac_building_key where available
LEFT JOIN fac_building fb ON fb.BUILDING_NUMBER = COALESCE(b.BUILDING_NUMBER, b_alt.BUILDING_NUMBER)
LEFT JOIN fac_building_address fba ON (
  -- try to join on BUILDING_NUMBER if that column exists in fba, otherwise try FAC_BUILDING_KEY
  COALESCE(fba.BUILDING_NUMBER, '') = COALESCE(b.BUILDING_NUMBER, b_alt.BUILDING_NUMBER)
  OR (fba.FAC_BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL AND fba.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY)
)
-- compute total distinct subjects per section
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    SECTION_ID,
    COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_CODE) AS TOTAL_SUBJECTS
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered
  GROUP BY SECTION_ID
) subj_counts ON subj_counts.SECTION_ID = co.SECTION_ID
-- unique non-null meeting times per section
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    SECTION_ID,
    COUNT(DISTINCT TRIM(MEET_TIME)) AS UNIQUE_MEET_TIMES
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered
  WHERE MEET_TIME IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(MEET_TIME) <> ''
  GROUP BY SECTION_ID
) mt ON mt.SECTION_ID = co.SECTION_ID
WHERE co.MEET_TIME IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(co.MEET_TIME) <> ''
  AND co.MEET_PLACE IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(co.MEET_PLACE) <> ''

rows.question: Consider only books cataloged on or after 2000. For each library material status and department, list the material status, department name, number of associated catalog items, and the total number of enrolled students in courses using those materials. Include subtotals for each material status and a grand total across all status (the corresponding status field is 'Grand Total').

WITH reserve_catalog_to_subject_offerings AS (
  SELECT
    lrd.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY`,
    lrd.`LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY`,
    lrd.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY`,
    lso.`NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS`,
    lso.`OFFER_DEPT_NAME`,
    lms.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS MATERIAL_STATUS,
    c.`CATALOG_RECORD_CREATE_DATE`
  FROM `library_reserve_matrl_detail` lrd
  LEFT JOIN `library_subject_offered` lso
    ON lrd.`LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY` = lso.`LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY`
  LEFT JOIN `library_material_status` lms
    ON lrd.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY` = lms.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY`
  LEFT JOIN `library_reserve_catalog` c
    ON lrd.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY` = c.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY`
  WHERE c.`CATALOG_RECORD_CREATE_DATE` IS NOT NULL
    AND STR_TO_DATE(c.`CATALOG_RECORD_CREATE_DATE`, '%Y-%m-%d') >= '2000-01-01'
    -- Only include rows where we have a material status and an offer department (per requirement)
    AND lms.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS` IS NOT NULL
    AND lso.`OFFER_DEPT_NAME` IS NOT NULL
)
,
per_dept AS (
  -- Per material status + department: distinct catalog items and sum of enrolled students across offerings.
  SELECT
    MATERIAL_STATUS,
    OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS NUM_CATALOG_ITEMS,
    SUM(COALESCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,0)) AS TOTAL_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
  FROM reserve_catalog_to_subject_offerings
  GROUP BY MATERIAL_STATUS, OFFER_DEPT_NAME
),
status_subtotals AS (
  -- Subtotal per material status (department label = '<MATERIAL_STATUS> Subtotal')
  SELECT
    MATERIAL_STATUS,
    CONCAT(MATERIAL_STATUS, ' Subtotal') AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS NUM_CATALOG_ITEMS,
    SUM(COALESCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,0)) AS TOTAL_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
  FROM reserve_catalog_to_subject_offerings
  GROUP BY MATERIAL_STATUS
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    'Grand Total' AS MATERIAL_STATUS,
    'Grand Total' AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS NUM_CATALOG_ITEMS,
    SUM(COALESCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,0)) AS TOTAL_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
  FROM reserve_catalog_to_subject_offerings
)
-- Union per-department rows, then per-status subtotals, then grand total
SELECT * FROM per_dept
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM status_subtotals
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM grand_total
ORDER BY
  -- Order by MATERIAL_STATUS alphabetically; ensure subtotals come immediately after their departments,
  -- by treating the subtotal department name as coming after other department names for same status.
  MATERIAL_STATUS ASC,
  CASE
    WHEN DEPARTMENT_NAME = CONCAT(MATERIAL_STATUS, ' Subtotal') THEN 2
    WHEN DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Grand Total' THEN 3
    ELSE 1
  END ASC,
  DEPARTMENT_NAME ASC

rows.question: For each course with enrolled students and with books in the library system, list the name of the department of that course, total number of courses using library materials, the number of catalog items associated with those courses, and the average enrollment per course. Include a grand total across all departments (the corresponding department field should be 'Grand Total').

WITH library_course_offering_rows AS (
SELECT
  `library_subject_offered`.`LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY` AS `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY`,

WHERE `library_subject_offered`.`TERM_CODE` IS NOT NULL
  AND `library_subject_offered`.`SUBJECT_ID` IS NOT NULL
),
department_key_name_for_offers AS (
SELECT
  `library_subject_offered`.`LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY` AS `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY`,

  `library_subject_offered`.`OFFER_DEPT_CODE` AS `OFFER_DEPT_CODE`
FROM
  `library_subject_offered`
),
library_reserve_material_links AS (
SELECT
  lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY AS LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY,
  lrm.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
  lrm.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID,
  lrm.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY AS LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
FROM library_reserve_matrl_detail AS lrm
WHERE lrm.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL
  AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL
  AND lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name,
  COUNT(*) AS num_courses_using_library_materials,
  SUM(m.num_catalog_items) AS num_catalog_items,
  ROUND(AVG(o.num_enrolled_students),2) AS avg_enrollment_per_course
FROM (
  -- distinct offerings that have enrolled students and at least one material
  SELECT
    lcor.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY,
    lcor.TERM_CODE,
    lcor.SUBJECT_ID,
    lcor.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
  FROM library_course_offering_rows lcor
  JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT TERM_CODE, SUBJECT_ID
    FROM library_reserve_material_links
  ) lrm ON lcor.TERM_CODE = lrm.TERM_CODE AND lcor.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID
  WHERE COALESCE(lcor.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,0) > 0
) o
JOIN department_key_name_for_offers d
  ON o.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = d.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
JOIN (
  -- count catalog items per offering (may be multiple rows per offering)
  SELECT
    LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY,
    COUNT(LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_catalog_items
  FROM library_reserve_material_links
  GROUP BY LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
) m ON o.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = m.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
GROUP BY d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'Grand Total' AS department_name,
  SUM(cnt.num_courses) AS num_courses_using_library_materials,
  SUM(cnt.num_catalog_items) AS num_catalog_items,
  ROUND(
    CASE WHEN SUM(cnt.num_courses)=0 THEN 0
         ELSE SUM(cnt.total_enrollment) / SUM(cnt.num_courses)
    END
  ,2) AS avg_enrollment_per_course
FROM (
  SELECT
    o.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY,
    1 AS num_courses,
    m.num_catalog_items,
    o.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS total_enrollment
  FROM (
    SELECT
      lcor.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY,
      lcor.TERM_CODE,
      lcor.SUBJECT_ID,
      lcor.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
    FROM library_course_offering_rows lcor
    JOIN (
      SELECT DISTINCT TERM_CODE, SUBJECT_ID
      FROM library_reserve_material_links
    ) lrm ON lcor.TERM_CODE = lrm.TERM_CODE AND lcor.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID
    WHERE COALESCE(lcor.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,0) > 0
  ) o
  JOIN (
    SELECT
      LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY,
      COUNT(LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_catalog_items
    FROM library_reserve_material_links
    GROUP BY LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  ) m ON o.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = m.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
) cnt

    AND at.ACADEMIC_YEAR = tp.ACADEMIC_YEAR

  AND COALESCE(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, '') <> ''

  FROM fac_rooms fr

),

-- main rows with rank per sector

    COALESCE(b.CAMPUS_SECTOR, 'UNSPECIFIED') AS CAMPUS_SECTOR,
    b.BUILDING_NAME,
    a.CITY,
    a.STATE,
    COALESCE(b.EXT_GROSS_AREA, 0) AS TOTAL_FLOORS, -- no explicit floors column; using EXT_GROSS_AREA as a substitute if appropriate
    COALESCE(b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, 0) AS TOTAL_ASSIGNABLE_AREA,

    -- extract leading token before first space or hyphen
    NULLIF(
      TRIM(
        SUBSTRING_INDEX(
          SUBSTRING_INDEX(cs.MEET_PLACE, ' ', 1),
          '-', 1
        )
      ),
      ''
    ) AS meet_building_number
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered cs
  WHERE cs.MEET_PLACE IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(cs.MEET_PLACE) <> ''
    AND cs.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL
),
term_code_to_academic_year AS (
  SELECT
    at.TERM_CODE        AS TERM_CODE,
    at.TERM_START_DATE  AS TERM_START_DATE,
    at.TERM_END_DATE    AS TERM_END_DATE,
    at.ACADEMIC_YEAR    AS ACADEMIC_YEAR
  FROM academic_terms at
  WHERE at.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL
    AND at.TERM_START_DATE IS NOT NULL
    AND at.TERM_END_DATE IS NOT NULL
),
building_number_to_name AS (
  SELECT
    b.BUILDING_NUMBER AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
    b.BUILDING_NAME   AS BUILDING_NAME
  FROM buildings b
  WHERE b.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL

  -- some schemas provide alternate building table; include if present
  SELECT
    f.BUILDING_NUMBER AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
    f.BUILDING_NAME   AS BUILDING_NAME
  FROM fac_building f
  WHERE f.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  s.SUBJECT_ID                                           AS subject_id,
  s.SUBJECT_TITLE                                        AS course_title,
  bn.BUILDING_NAME                                       AS building_name,
  -- convert term start/end strings to DATE; assume 'YYYY-MM-DD' format
  STR_TO_DATE(t.TERM_START_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d')             AS start_date,
  STR_TO_DATE(t.TERM_END_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d')               AS end_date,
  -- duration in days (end_date - start_date). This returns integer days (exclusive).
  DATEDIFF(
    STR_TO_DATE(t.TERM_END_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d'),
    STR_TO_DATE(t.TERM_START_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d')
  )                                                      AS duration_days,
  -- running average over window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows partitioned by academic year ordered by term start date
  AVG(
    DATEDIFF(
      STR_TO_DATE(t.TERM_END_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d'),
      STR_TO_DATE(t.TERM_START_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d')
    )
  ) OVER (
    PARTITION BY t.ACADEMIC_YEAR
    ORDER BY STR_TO_DATE(t.TERM_START_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d')
    ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING
  )                                                      AS running_avg_duration_5
FROM subject_offered_clean_meet_place s
JOIN term_code_to_academic_year t
  ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
JOIN building_number_to_name bn
  ON s.meet_building_number = bn.BUILDING_NUMBER
-- final filters to ensure dates and building match exist and academic year present
WHERE t.ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NOT NULL
  AND STR_TO_DATE(t.TERM_START_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') IS NOT NULL
  AND STR_TO_DATE(t.TERM_END_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY t.ACADEMIC_YEAR ASC, STR_TO_DATE(t.TERM_START_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') ASC

rows.question: For each course, list its name, name of the building of the course location, the start date, the name of the course before it, and the name of the course after it, access level of the building, and the assignable area of the room used for the course, sorted by the ascending order start date and course name.

SELECT
  so.SUBJECT_TITLE AS course_name,
  COALESCE(fb.BUILDING_NAME, ff.BUILDING_NAME, fr.BUILDING_NAME) AS building_name,
  COALESCE(at.TERM_START_DATE, si.IAP_DATE) AS start_date,
  LAG(so.SUBJECT_TITLE) OVER (
    PARTITION BY so.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
    ORDER BY COALESCE(at.TERM_START_DATE, si.IAP_DATE), so.SUBJECT_TITLE
  ) AS previous_course_name,
  LEAD(so.SUBJECT_TITLE) OVER (
    PARTITION BY so.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
    ORDER BY COALESCE(at.TERM_START_DATE, si.IAP_DATE), so.SUBJECT_TITLE
  ) AS next_course_name,
  -- use ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE from fac_building (fb/ff/fr) since ACCESS_LEVEL does not exist in schema
  COALESCE(fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, ff.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, fr.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE) AS access_level,
  -- use ASSIGNABLE_AREA or EXT_GROSS_AREA from fac_building/fac_building_address where available,
  -- fall back to BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE from buildings table if present
  COALESCE(fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA, fr.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, fr.EXT_GROSS_AREA, b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS assignable_area
FROM course_catalog_subject_offered AS so
LEFT JOIN academic_terms AS at
  ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT TERM_CODE, SUBJECT_ID, MEET_PLACE, MIN(IAP_DATE) AS IAP_DATE
  FROM subject_iap_schedule
  GROUP BY TERM_CODE, SUBJECT_ID, MEET_PLACE
) AS si
  ON si.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE
  AND si.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID
  AND si.MEET_PLACE = so.MEET_PLACE
-- primary attempt to find building info by matching MEET_PLACE to BUILDING_NUMBER in fac_building
LEFT JOIN fac_building AS fb
  ON fb.BUILDING_NUMBER = so.MEET_PLACE
-- second fac_building alias in case another record matches (keeps original intent)
LEFT JOIN fac_building AS ff
  ON ff.BUILDING_NUMBER = so.MEET_PLACE AND ff.FAC_BUILDING_KEY <> fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
-- fallback fac_building alias (keeps joinable keys)
LEFT JOIN fac_building AS fr
  ON fr.BUILDING_NUMBER = so.MEET_PLACE AND fr.FAC_BUILDING_KEY NOT IN (COALESCE(fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY,''), COALESCE(ff.FAC_BUILDING_KEY,''))
-- buildings table as additional fallback for assignable square footage
LEFT JOIN buildings AS b
  ON b.BUILDING_NUMBER = so.MEET_PLACE
WHERE so.MEET_PLACE IS NOT NULL
  AND (fb.BUILDING_NAME IS NOT NULL OR ff.BUILDING_NAME IS NOT NULL OR fr.BUILDING_NAME IS NOT NULL OR b.BUILDING_NAME IS NOT NULL)
ORDER BY
  COALESCE(at.TERM_START_DATE, si.IAP_DATE) ASC,

    `tip_detail`.`TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY` AS `TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY`,
    `tip_detail`.`RECORD_COUNT` AS `RECORD_COUNT`,

  FROM `tip_detail`

SELECT

  COALESCE(SUM(tma.record_count),0) AS TOTAL_MATERIAL_ASSIGNMENTS,
  AVG(tma.publication_year) AS AVG_PUBLICATION_YEAR,
  COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT tma.tip_material_status_key),0) AS NUM_DISTINCT_STATUSES

rows.question: For each publication year, list the year, the total number of reserved materials, the average length of their titles, distinct number of status, and number of courses, sorted by publication year in descending order.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH tip_material_normalized AS (
SELECT
  `tip_material`.`TIP_MATERIAL_KEY` AS `TIP_MATERIAL_KEY`,
  `tip_material`.`YEAR` AS `YEAR`,
  `tip_material`.`TITLE` AS `TITLE`,
  `tip_material`.`NEW_SHELF_PRICE` AS `NEW_SHELF_PRICE`,
  -- canonicalized title: trim and collapse internal whitespace, null-preserve
  (CASE WHEN `tip_material`.`TITLE` IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(`tip_material`.`TITLE`), '\\s+', ' ')
  END) AS `CANONICAL_TITLE`,
  -- title length (NULL-aware): length of canonical title, NULL if source TITLE is NULL
  (CASE WHEN `tip_material`.`TITLE` IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE CHAR_LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(`tip_material`.`TITLE`), '\\s+', ' '))
  END) AS `TITLE_LENGTH`
FROM
  `tip_material`
)
SELECT
  tmn.YEAR AS publication_year,
  COUNT(DISTINCT tmn.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_reserved_materials,
  AVG(tmn.TITLE_LENGTH) AS avg_title_length,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.status_key) AS distinct_number_of_status,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.course_key) AS number_of_courses
FROM tip_material_normalized tmn
JOIN (
  /* materials that appear in either tip_detail or library_reserve_matrl_detail */
  SELECT DISTINCT TIP_MATERIAL_KEY AS TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  FROM tip_detail
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY AS TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  FROM library_reserve_matrl_detail
) reserved_on USING (TIP_MATERIAL_KEY)
LEFT JOIN (
  /* gather status keys from both tip_detail and library_reserve_matrl_detail per material */
  SELECT
    td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY,
    td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY AS status_key
  FROM tip_detail td
  WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT
    lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY AS TIP_MATERIAL_KEY,
    lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY AS status_key
  FROM library_reserve_matrl_detail lrmd
  WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL
) s ON s.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tmn.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
LEFT JOIN (
  /* unify course identifiers from both sources: prefer SUBJECT_ID when available, else term|section fallback */
  SELECT
    td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY,
    CONCAT('TD|', td.TERM_CODE, '|', td.SUBJECT_ID) AS course_key
  FROM tip_detail td
  WHERE td.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT
    td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY,
    CONCAT('TD|', td.TERM_CODE, '|', td.SUBJECT_ID) AS course_key
  FROM tip_detail td
  WHERE td.SUBJECT_ID IS NULL AND td.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT
    lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY AS TIP_MATERIAL_KEY,
    CONCAT('LR|', IFNULL(lrmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, lrmd.SUBJECT_ID), '|', IFNULL(lrmd.TERM_CODE, '')) AS course_key
  FROM library_reserve_matrl_detail lrmd
) c ON c.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tmn.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
WHERE tmn.YEAR IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY tmn.YEAR
ORDER BY tmn.YEAR DESC

  FROM iap_subject_detail
),

  FROM iap_subject_session
)

  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY IS NOT NULL THEN d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY END) AS NUM_IAP_SESSIONS,
  -- count distinct subjects. Use combination of category + sponsor + session + term + activity title to identify a subject
  COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT_WS('||', COALESCE(d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY,''), COALESCE(d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY,''), COALESCE(d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY,''), COALESCE(d.TERM_CODE,''), COALESCE(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE,''))) AS NUM_UNIQUE_SUBJECTS

  ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
LEFT JOIN
  iap_subject_session_rows ss
  ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = ss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
GROUP BY

rows.question: List the names of the buildings with the most floors. If there are ties, list each one separately.

),

  FROM fac_floor_rows_clean
  GROUP BY `BUILDING_KEY`
),

FROM building_floor_counts fc

ORDER BY fc.FLOOR_COUNT DESC, b.BUILDING_NAME

rows.question: For subjects offered in the summer term, list the subject titles, number of instructors, and the length of the longest instructor name.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH subject_offered_summer_sections AS (
  SELECT
    `SECTION_ID` AS SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY,
    `TERM_CODE`,
    `SUBJECT_ID`,
    `SUBJECT_TITLE`,
    `RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME`
  FROM `course_catalog_subject_offered`
  WHERE `TERM_CODE` LIKE '%SU'
),
-- small numbers table for splitting comma-separated instructor lists (adjust max as needed)
nums AS (
  SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL
  SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL
  SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10
),
split_names AS (
  SELECT
    s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY,
    s.SUBJECT_ID,
    s.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    TRIM(
      SUBSTRING_INDEX(
        SUBSTRING_INDEX(s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ',', n.n),
        ',', -1
      )
    ) AS name
  FROM subject_offered_summer_sections s
  JOIN nums n
    ON s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME IS NOT NULL
       AND TRIM(s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME) <> ''
       AND (CHAR_LENGTH(s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME)
            - CHAR_LENGTH(REPLACE(s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ',', '')) + 1) >= n.n
)
SELECT
  sn.SUBJECT_TITLE AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sn.name) AS NUM_INSTRUCTORS,
  MAX(CHAR_LENGTH(sn.name)) AS MAX_INSTRUCTOR_NAME_LENGTH
FROM split_names sn
WHERE sn.name <> ''
GROUP BY sn.SUBJECT_ID, sn.SUBJECT_TITLE
ORDER BY NUM_INSTRUCTORS DESC, sn.SUBJECT_TITLE
